verdict.rationale: PostHog explicitly supports SQL/HogQL querying of raw events directly inside the platform (SELECT, FROM, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY), including joining events with data warehouse sources, and this is corroborated by MCP docs referencing running HogQL queries. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of SQL query correctness/performance at scale (a community comment raises unrelated LLM-cohort UX issues, not SQL querying itself).
